scope: Necessary order-four conditions for an arbitrary ETF(4,9), after anchoring one line and averaging moments over the S8 action on the other eight lines and over conjugation. PSD is imposed on the retained tail-S4 invariant test subspace of polynomials of degree <=2, split into eight characters. Feasibility establishes feasibility of this relaxation only.
extra_equality_scope: Caller-provided necessary identities; witnesses are preserved for independent audit.
representation: S8 orbits and conjugation fixed moments, first Gram row anchored at +mu
normalization: moment id 0 is the constant and equals 1
svec: Lower triangle, column-major, off-diagonal scaled by sqrt(2)
conic_signs: A x + s = b; rows first normalization, next exact equalities, then negative PSD svec maps
